summary: DEC-150: the generated capability block is gone from Nora's prompt — the tool schemas are the single source of truth for what she can do and when to reach for it. The two behavioural rules the block carried that schemas cannot express moved into conduct.md ('What you can actually do'): the closed-world rule (the tool list is the WHOLE of what she can do — no booking, phoning, ordering) and the sourcing rule (own confirmed/remembered sources before the open web). Prompt no longer carries the ~1.6k-token per-tool routing catalogue; routing triggers live in each tool's schema description.
details: Deleted ToolRegistry.capability(), live_only_tools(), web_tier_tools(), NativeTool.when/ToolSpec.when and all 48 when-clauses; loader DERIVED_KINDS/AUTHORITY_TERMINALS collapse to situation
conduct.md gains 'What you can actually do' with the DEC-90 closed-world clause and the E1/DEC-77 sourcing nudge, written by category with zero tool names (doctrine stays catalogue-free by gate)

recall_lookups schema docstring merges the DEC-92 evidence framing (it is your RECORD of what you actually checked — reach for it before re-running and whenever an earlier answer is doubted or you cannot tell whether you checked or guessed)
Authority chains across constraints/identity/voice/silence/conduct + navigation SKILL drop the capability rung
Full suite green (5414 tests); doctrine versions bumped (conduct 18, constraints 5, identity 6)
limitations: The live-only hint ('now/transit/where_is describe this moment only') was not re-rendered into conduct.md — it is covered by each tool's schema docstring and per-tool time_shiftable declarations; if post-deploy measurement shows the model quoting stale bus times, that sentence should be restored by-category
